scenario.name: r-cd-1-typed-delegate
scenario.description: Typed continue_delegate() schedule/spawn/return. Fires a delegate with a nonce-only child task, observes task ledger entry and parent return.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply exactly CD1-DONE {{nonce}} only after you arrive. Do not mutate files.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted (agent turn triggered for continue_delegate)

expectedReceipts.name: task-ledger-entry
expectedReceipts.description: Optional context only: generic task ledger row with nonce correlation (may be absent for continue_delegate)

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-key
expectedReceipts.description: Child session key or run ID from task metadata

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-scheduled-sentinel
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch CD1-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED sentinel emitted after continue_delegate tool result reports scheduled

expectedReceipts.name: parent-return-event
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch CD1-DONE or delegate.return evidence observed on parent session

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from tool response or task metadata for Tempo fetch

review.notes: Typed tool path. PASS-candidate when dispatch is accepted, CD1-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED is emitted after the tool result, and CD1-DONE/delegate.return is observed post-dispatch. task-ledger-entry is optional context only because continue_delegate often uses pending-delegate/subagent surfaces rather than generic tasks.list.

census.limits: Only 15 continuation.delegate.dispatch spans were accepted fleet-wide in 24h (184 in 7d), and none carried origin, session, turn, or run identity. A later reader holding this row’s trace-id cannot prove which dispatch it was without the harness artifact beside it.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_delegate evidence. Not causally joinable to the accepted-entry span today.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The row publishes a safe trace fingerprint and a public-safe Tempo projection. Prompt bodies, task text, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The typed continue_delegate schedule/spawn/return sequence produces a dispatch span, a fire span, and a tool-execution span sharing one non-zero trace.
controls.negative: A harness prompt echo and any unrelated delegate activity in the same trace window must not satisfy the return receipt; a trace that carries older unrelated activity must not upgrade the row.
controls.notes: Neither control can currently distinguish this row’s dispatch from another seat’s dispatch in the same window, because there is no proof marker and no entry identity.

backendUnavailable.notes: A trace-id lookup that returns nothing from a degraded Tempo is receipt debt, not a missing dispatch.

verdictAuthority.pass: Schedule, spawn, and parent return are observed on the gateway event stream with a trace receipt. This is a behavioral PASS only: it is not evidence that the dispatch can be re-identified from telemetry later.
verdictAuthority.partial: The trace receipt is missing, or the telemetry backend response lacks the declared completeness keys.
verdictAuthority.fail: The dispatch is accepted but no spawn or no parent return is observed.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-1-typed-delegate.js fires the typed tool and captures the receipts.
execution.manual: Manual Tempo review confirms span topology; it cannot supply the missing identity attributes.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row is the verdict authority. Manual review is corroboration and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Typed continue_delegate row (mode=normal). Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true for repeatability. Serialize per session (sameSessionConcurrencySafe=false). Ignore [k6-proof-harness] prompt echo; require explicit CD1-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED and CD1-DONE/delegate.return evidence.
